- airtable_oauth-update-table: Update an existing table. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-table)
Args:
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.
	warningAlert: 
	tableId: The Table ID.
	name: The updated name of the table
	description: The updated description of the table
- airtable_oauth-update-record: Update a single record in a table by Record ID. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-record)
Args:
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.
	warningAlert: 
	tableId: The Table ID.
	recordId: Identifier of a record
	returnFieldsByFieldId: If set to `true`, the returned field objects will have the field ID as the key, instead of the field name.
- airtable_oauth-update-field: Update an existing field in a table. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-field)
Args:
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.
	warningAlert: 
	tableId: The Table ID.
	fieldId: The field to update
	name: The new name of the field
	description: The new description of the field
- airtable_oauth-update-comment: Update an existing comment on a selected record. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/update-comment)
Args:
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.
	warningAlert: 
	tableId: The Table ID.
	recordId: Identifier of a record
	commentId: Identifier of a comment
	comment: The new content of the comment
- airtable_oauth-search-records: Search for a record by formula or by field value. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-records)
Args:
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.
	warningAlert: 
	tableId: The Table ID.
	searchMethod: Select the search method to use
	returnFieldsByFieldId: If set to `true`, the returned field objects will have the field ID as the key, instead of the field name.
- airtable_oauth-list-tables: Get a list of tables in the selected base. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-base-schema)
Args:
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.
- airtable_oauth-list-records: Retrieve records from a table, optionally sorting and filtering results. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-records)
Args:
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.
	warningAlert: 
	tableId: The Table ID.
	sortFieldId: Optionally select a field to sort results by. To sort by multiple fields, use the **Filter by Formula** field.
	sortDirection: If sorting by a field, which direction to sort by.
	maxRecords: The maximum number of records to return. Leave blank to retrieve all records.
	filterByFormula: Optionally provide a [formula (see info on the documentation)](https://support.airtable.com/hc/en-us/articles/203255215-Formula-Field-Reference) used to filter records. The formula will be evaluated for each record, and if the result is not `0`, `false`, `""`, `NaN`, `[]`, or `#Error!` the record will be included in the response. For example, to only include records where `Name` isn't empty, use `NOT({Name} = '')`.
	returnFieldsByFieldId: If set to `true`, the returned field objects will have the field ID as the key, instead of the field name.
- airtable_oauth-list-records-in-view: Retrieve records from a view, optionally sorting and filtering results. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-views)
Args:
	accountTierAlert: 
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.
	warningAlert: 
	tableId: The Table ID.
	viewId: The View ID.
	sortFieldId: Optionally select a field to sort results by. To sort by multiple fields, use the **Filter by Formula** field.
	sortDirection: If sorting by a field, which direction to sort by.
	maxRecords: The maximum number of records to return. Leave blank to retrieve all records.
	filterByFormula: Optionally provide a [formula (see info on the documentation)](https://support.airtable.com/hc/en-us/articles/203255215-Formula-Field-Reference) used to filter records. The formula will be evaluated for each record, and if the result is not `0`, `false`, `""`, `NaN`, `[]`, or `#Error!` the record will be included in the response. For example, to only include records where `Name` isn't empty, use `NOT({Name} = '')`.
	returnFieldsByFieldId: If set to `true`, the returned field objects will have the field ID as the key, instead of the field name.
- airtable_oauth-list-bases: Get the list of bases that can be accessed. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/list-bases)
Args:
	airtable: 
- airtable_oauth-get-record: Get data of a selected record from a table. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/get-record)
Args:
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.
	warningAlert: 
	tableId: The Table ID.
	returnFieldsByFieldId: If set to `true`, the returned field objects will have the field ID as the key, instead of the field name.
	recordId: Identifier of a record
- airtable_oauth-get-record-or-create: Get a specific record, or create one if it doesn't exist. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-records)

- airtable_oauth-delete-record: Delete a selected record from a table. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/delete-record)
Args:
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.
	warningAlert: 
	tableId: The Table ID.
	recordId: Identifier of a record
- airtable_oauth-create-table: Create a new table. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-table)
Args:
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.

	description: The description of the table

	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.
	warningAlert: 
	tableId: The Table ID.

- airtable_oauth-create-multiple-records: Create one or more records in a table in a single operation with an array. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-records)
Args:
	airtable: 
	baseId: The Base ID.

- airtable_oauth-create-field: Create a new field in a table. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-field)
Args:

	warningAlert: 
	tableId: The Table ID.

	description: The description of the field

- airtable_oauth-create-comment: Create a comment on a selected record. [See the documentation](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/create-comment)
